en.title: How to Use AI for All Your Writing While Avoiding AI Slop
en.hook: Five practical tips to boost writing efficiency with AI without sacrificing quality
key_takeaways: Leverage AI tools for drafting but maintain human oversight to ensure quality
Establish style guidelines and feedback loops to prevent AI slop
Balance automation with manual editing to achieve both efficiency and accuracy
